messages:
alex: Heads up — release window opens ~18h from now (cutoff 09:00 PT tomorrow). We need final sign-offs: version bumps, changelog, QA gates, and security review. Tagging @maria @tj @sasha for their parts. :eyes:

maria: On docs/changelog. Can someone drop the PR link for the changelog entry? I'll put the user-facing bit in docs and link to it.

alex: PR is #5823 — version bump in package.json + CHANGELOG.md entry in that PR. Also there's a small note about telemetry opt-out that needs copy.

tj: QA plan: smoke + regression + one targeted e2e focused on the routing change. I can run smoke now if we cut a staging canary tonight. Need the build tag. :+1:

kevin: Security quick pass done: found a minor hardcoded env var in auth middleware (not prod-secret), opened #5830 with fix. No blocker if tests cover it. @sasha please confirm the threat model note.

sasha: Reviewing #5830 now. Left a comment about token expiry handling — should be quick. If tests pass, I won't block.

jen: I pushed the version bump to release/v1.12 (branch: release/v1.12). Bumped package.json to 1.12.0-rc and added CHANGELOG header. Commands I ran:
```
git checkout -b release/v1.12
sed -i 's/1.11.3/1.12.0-rc/' package.json
git commit -am "chore(release): bump to 1.12.0-rc"
git push origin release/v1.12
```

alex: Nice. Reminder: update release-notes.md with the PR list and set the release flag in the console before cutover. Also please add a short blurb for the public changelog (1-2 sentences).

maria: I'll add the public blurb in release-notes.md now and link the internal changelog. Pulling copy from PR description.

tj: Staging canary window request: 03:00-04:00 PT. Can we run canary with 5% traffic and rolling back to golden model on any 5xx spike >0.5%?

alex: Yes, canary policy approved. Deploy-bot, schedule canary 03:00 PT with metric triggers: 5xx >0.5% or latency p95 > 500ms.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1769535600 (03:00 PT). Monitoring hooks enabled, rollback policy set as requested.

kevin: One more thing — security release checklist: make sure SCA scan and dependency pinning are documented in the release notes. I added a short paragraph in the internal checklist doc.

sasha: Verified SCA scan ran on CI and no new high CVEs. Good to go from security after CI green.

alex: Great. Final asks before cutoff: PRs merged into release/v1.12, github release notes populated, docs updated, QA signoff in the checklist, security signoff comment in the PR. If you won't make cutoff, call it out now.

maria: I will finish docs in the next 30m. :thumbsup:

tj: QA will post signoff comment once smoke passes (~45m).

jen: All merges pushed. Waiting on QA + docs signoff.

sasha: Security signoff pending final CI run but looks clear.

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll do a final sweep 30m before cutoff and nudge any outstanding items. :rocket:
